recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the underlying Bundle uniqueness model.
issue_request: FHIR-25281 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue asking overview-dev.html#search-response to clarify that the uniqueness rule for entry.resource.id in some Bundles is about the combination of id and type, not id alone.
initial_application: Commit d04313e9e9e7d5d8b263d4127d3a496fe87e259b, titled "Text change for FHIR-25281", applied the clarification in source/overview-dev.html by changing the note from entry.resource.id itself being unique to the combination of resource type and entry.resource.id being unique.
additional_context: source/overview-dev.html is in current build/navigation scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and the note links to the active Bundle uniqueness section at source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml#bundle-unique. Later FHIR-38768 work corrected the same note's line reference and spelling while preserving the FHIR-25281 meaning. FHIR-I WGM 202001 minutes record FHIR-25281 as agreed to clarify, and community searches found no conflicting FHIR-25281-specific discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative source already contains the requested type-plus-id uniqueness wording.
